clauses.title: The CLI declares the two manifest builders and required_evidence_check
requires: build_manifest_capture: { required: ['overlay', 'cwd'], optional: [] },
build_manifest_compare: { required: ['captured', 'cwd'], optional: [] },
required_evidence_check: { required: ['cwd', 'requiredEvidence'], optional: [] },

clauses.title: The manifest builders derive every value from a producing operation
requires: CL-D61: the two manifest_compare requests derive every value from a producing operation —
the frozen overlay's parent and authorized set, the capture's parent — so a request carrying
both mode fields (the PR #103 killer) is unrepresentable here.
const problem = inputShapeProblem('overlay_compare', { cwd: data.cwd, overlay: data.overlay });
return built('build_manifest_compare', 'manifest_compare', { cwd: data.cwd, parent, manifest: captured }, { from: 'manifest', to: 'captured' });

clauses.title: A required-evidence file that does not exist is an assembly error
requires: CL-D61: a required-evidence entry naming a file that does not exist is an assembly error to
catch before any gate runs (PR #104 spent Terra's only retry on one), never a gate outcome.
fail('invalid_request', 'required_evidence_presence', `required evidence source is not an existing file (${kind}): ${entry.source}`, entry.source);

clauses.title: The autofix driver captures at AFTER_STAGING and compares at BEFORE_COMMIT through the builders, and checks the evidence set
requires: const manifest = step('manifest_compare', step('build_manifest_capture', { overlay, cwd: ws }).request.data); // AFTER_STAGING
step('manifest_compare', step('build_manifest_compare', { captured: manifest, cwd: ws }).request.data); // BEFORE_COMMIT
run.op('required_evidence_check', { cwd: s.workspace, requiredEvidence });

clauses.title: The review-only driver checks the evidence set before building the expectation
requires: run.op('required_evidence_check', { cwd: s.checkout, requiredEvidence: s.requiredEvidence });

clauses.title: A required file that does not exist is an assembly error, never a gate outcome
requires: every `file`-kind entry of that set must exist, verified through packaged `required_evidence_check` before the expectation is built
a required file that does not exist is an assembly error and never a gate outcome (CL-D61)

clauses.title: Builder and check fixtures pin the surface, the unrepresentable request, the round trip, and the record
requires: the CLI table and the builders name the manifest builders and the evidence check
the CLI exposes the two builders and the check with frozen inputs
a request carrying both mode fields cannot be produced by a builder
the built requests round-trip through manifest_compare at AFTER_STAGING and BEFORE_COMMIT
every built capture request passes the consumer's authorized-path rules, differentially
required_evidence_check makes a nonexistent required file an assembly error
CL-D61 records the builders, the check, and the CL-D56 widening
